test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The green leaves of plants absorb the carbon dioxide.

options.text: The carbon dioxide is absorbed by the green leaves of plants.
The carbon dioxide absorbs the green leaves of plants.
The green leaves are absorbed by the carbon dioxide of plants.
The carbon dioxide is being absorbed by the green leaves of plants.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The carbon dioxide is absorbed by the green leaves of plants.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing the given sentence into passive voice.
 
• The **subject **in the active voice becomes the **object **in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject "**green leaves of plants**" in the active voice becomes the object in the passive voice.
 
• The given sentence in passive voice will have "**is**" as the helping verb followed by the main verb.
 
• The main verb "**absorb**" will take the past participle form "**absorbed**" in passive voice.
 
• The **agent**(one who performs the action) in the sentence comes after the preposition "**by**" in the passive voice.

**The correct sentence in passive voice is:*** The carbon dioxide is absorbed by the green leaves of plants.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The structure of the active voice sentence is : **subject + verb + object.**
 
• The structure of the passive voice sentence is :** object + verb + by + subject(agent).**
